**Central and L p -concentration of 1-Lipschitz maps into R -trees**

*By Kei FUNANO*

24 pp, 14 sections.

**Abstract.** In this paper, we study the Le´vy-Milman concentration phenomenon of 1-Lipschitz maps from mm-spaces to R-trees. Our main theorems assert that the concentration to R-trees is equivalent to the concentration to the real line.
